answer: An agent network prevents Sybil attacks by requiring each node to post an escalating bond before joining governance, creating a financial ledge where fraudulent clones face immediate liquidation. Rather than offering a safe haven for cheap disposable bots, each identity must commit tokens locked for multiple rounds. If an attacker attempts to flood voting pools, verifiable attestation slashes their entire deposit, turning what seemed like an automated sonnet of synthetic praise into a direct capital loss scaling at O(N) with the number of spawned identities.
